spr.headline: Housing revenue grows as Springfield moves to net bank cash
spr.summary: Private and affordable housing revenue increased, while lower land sales reduced group revenue and profit. The board proposes a higher dividend and plans a share buyback.
spr.what_changed: Springfield plans to develop its remaining Central Scotland sites rather than sell them, alongside the worker-housing opportunity in the North of Scotland.
what_matters: Reported profit fell as land sales reduced. The year-end cash figure precedes £20.7m of deferred acquisition payments. The dividend requires shareholder approval.
